name: Lucy Turnbull
bio:
Lucy Turnbull is a Canadian actress and has been acting since age six, booking her first professional acting role at age seven.

She has appeared in films such as Eternity and Blue Heron as well as television shows such as Black Mirror and The Miniature Wife.
